title: Class DbDriver lacks a docstring
detail: DbDriver is a concrete servicegroup driver with no class docstring. Add a brief description of the database-backed heartbeat mechanism and the _report_state callback.

title: Broad 'except Exception' in _report_state can silently swallow unexpected errors
detail: Line 117 catches all Exceptions during periodic service state reporting. Unexpected errors (network, DB failures) may only be logged and swallowed, so a misbehaving service can continue without its state being recorded. Narrow the except clause to known exception types or re-raise after logging.
